description: Contains the implementation of RailsAdapter, a RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of VodRail items with horizontally scrolling child items in an Android application.

classes.name: RailsAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for a RecyclerView that displays a list of VodRail objects, each with a horizontally scrolling list of VodItems.

classes.name: RailViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder for individual rails, managing the title and nested RecyclerView of VodItems.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item view and creates a RailViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a VodRail item to the ViewHolder, setting up the nested RecyclerView.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of VodRail items.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a VodRail to the ViewHolder, setting the title and initializing the inner RecyclerView.
